 MEDIA ADVISORY 
 November 5, 2026 
 First ODI between India and Sri Lanka shifted from Delhi to Visakhapatnam 
 The venue for the first Muthoot FinCorp ODI between India and Sri Lanka, scheduled to be played on December 13, 2026, has been shifted from Delhi to Visakhapatnam.
 The venue change has been made following a request from the Delhi and District Cricket Association (DDCA), in view of the potential weather disruption and the proposed renovation work at the stadium.
 The match will now be played at the ACA-VDCA Cricket Stadium in Visakhapatnam on December 13, 2026.
